title: RRC NFR Recruitment 2026 – ALP, Technician, Junior Engineer, Train Manager Posts
shortInfo: RRC NFR has announced notification for ALP, Technician, Junior Engineer, Train Manager posts. Required qualification: Matriculation/SSLC, ITI, Diploma, Degree. Last date to apply: 17-10-26.

dates.event: Date of Publication of Notification on Website
Opening Date and Time of Online Applications
Last Date for Uploading Scanned Copy of Forwarded Online Application
Closing Date and Time of Online Applications

howToApply: Visit the Notice Board of the official website of RRC-NFR and click on ‘Online Application for GDCE-01/2026, N.F. Railway for the posts of ALP, Technicians, JE & Train Manager’.
Read the notification and instructions carefully, then click on the ‘New Registration’ link.
Fill in Employment details: Designation, Controlling Officer, IPAS/Employee No., HRMS ID, Unit Name, Division, Department, Place of Posting, Railway Station Code, etc.
Fill in Personal Information: Name, Father’s name, Date of Birth, Community, e-mail Address, mobile number, AADHAAR number, Identification Marks, Address, etc.
After filling basic details, an e-mail with a unique Application Number will be sent to the registered e-mail ID. Login using the Application Number and Date of Birth.
Fill in Educational Qualifications (starting from Class-10 onwards: Class-12, ITI/CCAA, Diploma, Graduation, Post-Graduation).
Submit Post Preferences (if eligible for more than one post). No change in preferences will be allowed after submission.
Indicate ITI trade (for ALP/Technician posts) or Exam Group (for JE posts).
Upload scanned copies of photograph, self-attested certificates, community certificates (if applicable), and other required documents.
Double-check all details and submit the application. No changes will be entertained after final submission.

Take a printout of the filled-up online application, get it forwarded by the Controlling Officer (minimum Jr. Scale grade), and upload the scanned copy on the website within the closing date. This is mandatory.
Candidates need NOT send print-outs or copies of certificates to RRC by post.

title: IOCL Bongaigaon Recruitment 2026 – Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: IOCL Bongaigaon has announced notification for Apprentice posts. Required qualification: B.Sc, Diploma. Last date to apply: 18-10-26.

dates.event: Opening of Online Application (NAPS/NATS & Microsoft Forms)
Last Date of Submission of Online Application (NAPS/NATS & Microsoft Forms)
Tentative Date of Document Verification (04th to 06th November 2026)

howToApply: Visit the IOCL official website at www.iocl.com from 28.09.2026.

Step I: For Post Codes 101 & 103, register on NAPS portal at https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/. For Post Code 107, register on NATS portal at https://nats.education.gov.in. Apply for the relevant apprenticeship opportunity using the Establishment ID for Bongaigaon Refinery (NATS: EASCHC000001, NAPS: E07191800001).
Ensure your NAPS/NATS profile is 100% correctly updated with personal details, educational details, category, and aggregate percentage.

Step II: After applying on NAPS/NATS portal, mandatorily fill in additional details on Microsoft Forms by visiting the link at www.iocl.com. The form opens at 10:00 hours on 28.09.2026 and closes at 17:00 hours on 18.10.2026.
Ensure the same e-mail ID and mobile number are used in both NAPS/NATS portal and Microsoft Forms.
Both Step I and Step II must be completed for a valid application. Submission at only one step will result in rejection.
Candidates can apply for only one trade/discipline of their choice.

howToApply: Visit the official Assam Rifles website at assam-rifles.gov.in.
Click on the ‘ONLINE APPLICATION’ option on the website.
Fill in the required details as prescribed in the application form.
After filling the application, make online payment via the link given for online payment OR payment can be made at SBI Branch as well.
Upload a copy of the payment receipt/challan.
Candidates must produce the original copy of payment receipt/challan at the time of RFID Based Physical Standard Test (PST) / Physical Efficiency Test (PET).
Candidates must also produce the printed copy of the online Application Form duly completed and a copy of the certificate downloaded from the Assam Rifles website.
Only a single application per candidate will be accepted through online mode. Multiple applications will not be accepted.
After submission of the online application form, no change/correction/modification will be allowed under any circumstances.

howToApply: Visit the official CPRI website at https://cpri.res.in/ and navigate to the recruitment/career section.
Before registering, ensure you have a valid self e-mail ID and mobile number, scanned passport size color photograph, scanned signature, and scanned copies of all required certificates in PDF format.
Register and fill in the online application form with accurate and complete information.

Upload scanned photograph, signature, and all required documents (SSLC/SSC/Matriculation Certificate, Degree/Diploma/ITI Trade Certificate & Marks card, experience certificate, BCC certificate from NIELIT, Caste/Category Certificate, NOC, Ex-servicemen ID card & Discharge Certificate, as applicable).
Pay the prescribed application fee online (inclusive of GST). SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-servicemen/Women are exempted from payment of fees.
Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate online application forms for each post with separate fees.
Take a printout of the submitted application form and retain it for future reference.
Online Registration Opening: 19.09.2026 (10:00 AM); Closing: 12.10.2026 (05:00 PM).

howToApply: Visit BCPL official website www.bcplonline.co.in and navigate to the Careers section.
Read the detailed advertisement carefully and ensure you meet all eligibility criteria before applying.
Register online and fill in the Application Form with accurate details including personal, educational, and experience information.

Upload required documents: passport size photograph, signature, proof of age, caste/category certificate, disability certificate (if applicable), mark sheets, qualification certificates, and experience certificates in digital format (.jpg/.pdf, max 200 KB).
Pay the application fee online through the payment gateway available on the website (Rs. 200/- for General/EWS/OBC(NCL); SC/ST/PwBD candidates are exempted).
Submit the online Application Form and download the system-generated Pay-in slip and Registration Slip with unique registration number.
Keep a copy of the Application Form with unique application sequence number for future reference.
Candidates are NOT required to send hard copy of the Application Form to BCPL.
If called for further Selection Process, bring the downloaded Application Form along with all original documents and one self-attested photocopy set.
